simulationNote: Try a transfer mandate with demo tokens. Activity in this workspace is saved locally.
headline: You set the transfer limits.
intro: The agent prepares a request. Check the recipient and amount, approve the plan and simulate its execution.
scenarioHelp: The sequence creates a new demo mandate and tries amounts of 30, 80, 50 and 25. It then revokes the mandate and tries 1. Previous history is preserved.
policyHelp: A new mandate starts a fresh spending limit. Previous requests and demo balances are preserved.
requestHelp: The plan is checked before approval.
amountHelp: Up to six decimal places. For example, 12,5.
reviewHelp: Approval applies only to the plan shown here.
eventsHelp: Each request has its own row. Open its details to review the decision and demo balance changes.
emptyHelp: Prepare a request or run the example sequence.
evidenceHelp: This receipt records demo activity. No blockchain transfer has been made.
scenarioPassed: The example sequence matched expectations. Two transfers were simulated and three requests were blocked.
scenarioFailed: The example sequence differed from expectations. Review the activity.
grantDone: The new demo mandate is active.
revokeDone: The mandate has been revoked. Further execution is blocked.
networkError: The connection to the local app was lost. Refresh the state before continuing.
setupHelp: The synthetic MDT simulation runs independently. Use the separate Sepolia preparation workspace to review the fixed offline proposal and its unsigned transactions.
localSaved: History is saved on this computer.

checks.SIMULATION_ONLY: Request belongs to the local demo
checks.IDENTITY: Owner and agent match the mandate
checks.TRANSACTION_LIMIT: Amount fits the limit per transfer
checks.CUMULATIVE_LIMIT: Amount fits the remaining total limit

blockedReasons.SIMULATION_ONLY: The request does not belong to this demo.
blockedReasons.IDENTITY: The owner, agent or chain does not match the mandate.
blockedReasons.POLICY_CURRENT: The mandate changed after the request was prepared.
blockedReasons.POLICY_ACTIVE: The owner has revoked the mandate.
blockedReasons.TRANSACTION_LIMIT: The amount exceeds the limit per transfer.
blockedReasons.CUMULATIVE_LIMIT: The amount exceeds the remaining total limit.
blockedReasons.BALANCE: The owner demo balance is insufficient.
blockedReasons.ALLOWANCE: The demo token allowance is insufficient.
